title: Intermittent test failure on `systems::test::correct_transforms_when_no_children` in `bevy_transform`

labels.name: C-Testing
labels.description: A change that impacts how we test Bevy or how users test their apps

labels.name: A-Tasks
labels.description: Tools for parallel and async work

body:
## Bevy version

Any recent commit, like https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/commit/fb74ca3d4644cf31afefe62ecd5e566794211290 or https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/commit/a09dd034a2695dec504fbe45c4441cc459c9b08d

## Relevant system information

Windows 11, stable 1.64.0

## What you did

`cargo run -p ci` on my machine

## Additional information

The same command almost always works ok (i.e., the test passes) if I run it immediately afterwards.
